item.title: Raspberry Pi Video Synth with Blinka and Processing
item.description: Use Blinka and Processing together to control fun animations! Video synthesizers can create fun and funky visual effects on screens. In this project, you’ll learn how to use Processing and Blinka, the CircuitPython compatibility library for single-board computers running Linux, to display animations and control them with hardware. Check out the guide.
